title: Base knowledge and usage FAQ
intro: Common questions about scheduling, roster imports and MAA integration.
boundary: The knowledge base explains mechanics and trade-offs. Generate a complete plan in the calculator using your roster, room levels and rotation settings.
attribution: Summaries adapted from original RIIC-knowledge documents maintained by 公孙长乐, with English translations added. These originals use CC BY 4.0; the full repository has licenses by content section.
maaQuestion: How do I import a schedule into MAA?
maaAnswer: Export the generated MAA custom base JSON and import it in MAA.
boxAnswer: Check whether the all-operator sample is selected. Replace it in Configure Box and Layout with Skland data or Arknights_OperBox_Export.json from MAA, then regenerate.
fillerQuestion: Why assign operators without a relevant base skill?
fillerAnswer: They may fill empty slots or support other operators. Check useful skill holders and assess the whole plan; replacing useful members with fillers can reduce output.
shiftsAnswer: These are shift hours: three shifts over 24 hours, three over 36 hours, or a main/backup pair over 24 hours respectively. One half may continue working across shifts.
dronesQuestion: Can I change the drone target?
dronesAnswer: Open the current plan in manual scheduling, change drone targets, then export the updated MAA configuration.
fiammettaQuestion: Why is Fiammetta unused when enabled?
fiammettaAnswer: Ownership, a supported rotation and legal targets are also required. Enabling her does not require use every shift. Regenerate after changes.
dormQuestion: Why do replaced operators not enter dormitories?
dormAnswer: Put dormitories last in MAA’s facility execution order and review locked occupants and autofill settings before execution.
busyQuestion: What if a request queues or fails?
busyAnswer: Stop repeated submissions, wait for the request and cooldown, then retry once. Check network and sign-in; include errors, request ID and roster source in feedback.
